info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Maple Laptop Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Maple Laptop Detail Management API enables businesses to create and manage detailed attributes for Maple Laptop products in their catalog. This API supports the addition of essential specifications, features, and pricing information. Typical users include product managers and e-commerce platforms that aim to enhance their product offerings with comprehensive details. By utilizing this API, organizations can ensure that their catalog reflects accurate and robust product information for better customer engagement and sales.

post.summary: Create details for a Maple Laptop.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create detailed information for a Maple Laptop. You can specify various attributes related to the laptop's specifications, features, and additional options required for inventory purposes.

requestBody.description: Request body for submitting details related to a Maple laptop. It should contain all necessary information in JSON format as defined by the schema.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the details.
